# basemapper

> Headless spatial basemap renderer for Python

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Basemap views
> Create a view (`basemap()`), change it (`set_view`, `set_bounds`), read it (`get_bounds`, `get_center`, `get_zoom`, `get_size`) and render it (`render_png`, `render_svg`, `render_array`). The same functions and arguments exist in R.


- [basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/basemap.html): Create a basemap view
- [Basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.html): A map view rendered headlessly: one style, or several stacked

#### Basemap Methods
> Methods for the Basemap class

- [Basemap.set_view](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.set_view.html)
- [Basemap.set_bounds](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.set_bounds.html)
- [Basemap.get_bounds](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.get_bounds.html)
- [Basemap.get_center](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.get_center.html)
- [Basemap.get_zoom](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.get_zoom.html)
- [Basemap.get_size](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.get_size.html)
- [Basemap.get_attribution](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.get_attribution.html)
- [Basemap.__repr__](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.__repr__.html)
- [Basemap.render_array](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.render_array.html)
- [Basemap.render_png](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.render_png.html)
- [Basemap.render_svg](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/Basemap.render_svg.html)

#### One-shot rendering
> Render bounds to an RGBA array in one call.

- [render_basemap_raw](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/render_basemap_raw.html): Render a basemap for bounds in one call

#### Plot integrations
> Drop a basemap layer into an existing plot, rendered at the output resolution. `geom_basemap` takes the same arguments in plotnine and ggplot2 (R).


- [add_basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/add_basemap.html): Render a basemap beneath existing axes content
- [geom_basemap](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/geom_basemap.html): Render a styled basemap beneath plotnine spatial layers

#### Styles
> Named basemaps (leaflet-providers names, usable as `style`), styles for your own tile data, and OGC services. Tile data (tile URLs, TileJSON, PMTiles, ArcGIS services) also works as `style` directly.


- [basemap_provider](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/basemap_provider.html): A named basemap's style
- [list_providers](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/list_providers.html): The basemaps :func:`basemap_provider` knows
- [providers](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/providers.html): Basemap names of one provider, as attributes
- [tile_style](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/tile_style.html): A style for tile data, with overrides
- [wms_style](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/wms_style.html): Style for an OGC WMS GetMap endpoint, as 256 px tiles in EPSG:3857
- [wmts_style](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/wmts_style.html): Style for an OGC WMTS GetTile (KVP) endpoint. A RESTful WMTS

#### Style layers and attribution
> A style's layers with their features, for the `layers` and `features` filters, and the attribution text it asks maps to show.


- [list_layers](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/list_layers.html): List a style's layers, or preview a filter
- [get_attribution](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/get_attribution.html): The attribution text a style asks maps to show

#### Tile cache

- [tile_cache](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/tile_cache.html): The disk cache for map tiles

#### Exceptions

- [BasemapError](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/BasemapError.html): Base exception for all basemapper errors
- [ValidationError](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/ValidationError.html): Raised for invalid bbox, dimensions, zoom, or layer filter
- [StyleError](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/StyleError.html): Raised when a style cannot be fetched or parsed
- [NetworkError](https://ar-puuk.github.io/basemapper/python/reference/NetworkError.html): Raised when tile or style network requests fail
